SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] "A woman's beauty lies in her personality. It lies in 
her passion."

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] - Auguste Rodin

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] This is the Kousaka household, located somewhere 
in Chiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] In this residence, worried maidens assemble, 
seeking answers from the master of life, every night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Now then, I wonder who tonight's guest will be...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Um... Pardon my intrusion.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I heard you can get a life counseling session here...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Indeed. This is a place dedicated to guiding youths 
such as you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Great. It looked just like my best friend's house, so 
I was a bit surprised.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] And you are?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I am Aragaki Ayase, a third year middle school 
student.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm Kousaka Daisuke. You can address me as 
Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes. I'll be in your care, Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] So, what is it that you need counseling for?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Well, about that...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I want to know what makes a good woman from a 
man’s perspective.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] A man’s criterion of good women...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes... Just a general opinion is fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Like, what kind of woman would a man like, and 
such...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hm... You've come all the way here, but 
unfortunately...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll have to refrain from answering that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Why is that?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] A man's preference, the conveniently ideal woman, 
is an illusion.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I cannot give my advice over becoming someone 
that doesn't exist.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It's wonderful that you're ready to work hard for 
your partner, but you won’t last if you destroy 
your real self.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It's fine. I will definitely become his ideal.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] If it's for my beloved, I know I can do it!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Someday... I want to be able to create a warm and 
loving family.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] One where my husband can come home from 
work and leisurely take off his necktie in peace.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] And if I had time, I could add to our income by 
working part-time, managing our kitchen garden, 
and...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Shoot, I'm just talking about myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Anyway, I just want to make him feel like our 
home is a place where he can come back and be 
cozy.
[FI] You're a pretty honest and diligent girl, huh.

[FI] If only the other girls coming here could be like 
her...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You want to know what it takes to become a good 
woman?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, I don't see much reason for you to worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Why is that?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] To be willing to work hard for your partner...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I believe that alone is the best qualification as the 
ideal woman.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] R-Really? Thank you very much!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Being loved by a girl like you would keep any man 
from going astray. Don't worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] W-Well... I don't think so.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] There are a lot of wonderful girls around the guy I 
like...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Even if I can say we're dating, I don't think I can 
really feel at ease.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Then you just have to make him yours. So he 
wouldn't be able to cheat on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Of course. That's what I plan to do.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Besides, if he was cheating on me... I would kill him. 
Hehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes. That's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] You're not going to say I can't kill him?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's not like you'll really kill him, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] O-Of course not! ...Hahaha.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] But even if I want to be more tolerant, I sometimes 
get caught up in dark thoughts...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Don't let that change your feelings for your partner. 
You just have to remember that your feelings for 
him are the most important.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes, I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I-I'm glad you understand!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I think it would be wonderful if he would turn out 
to be a nice husband like you, Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Oh, I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] However, I am a very rigid man. I don't know how 
much trouble that caused for my wife.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] That's not true.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No... For starters, I've left raising our children to her 
by using my work as a pretext.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm really grateful to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] That's so wonderful...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Sensei, is there a secret formula to making love last 
as long as yours?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] A secret formula to making love last this long, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Let's see... I guess there is one thing that could 
count as that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] If he cheats on you, give up on him.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Wha--?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] W-What are you saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm telling you that if you've chosen a man like that, 
it's partly your own fault and you should give up 
on him.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I... I can't just give up on him!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Rather, blame your own narrow-mindedness if that 
happens.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] M-My own...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Creating a family is not an extension of your time as 
lovers.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] But lovers will still become a family if they marry, 
won't they?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Besides, what's the point of dating if being lovers 
won't lead to anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Then let me ask you this, what is the meaning 
behind the ceremony called marriage?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Um, that's...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It basically means that being lovers and being 
married are two completely different things.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you're lovers, you can just break up if you lose 
interest in each other. However, that is not the case 
for a married couple.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] For example, even if there is a situation that's 100% 
your partner's fault, that's something both of you 
have to resolve together.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] You need to have that resolve.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Naturally, this isn't limited to cheating. If any 
problem makes you feel like breaking up, then it’s 
meaningless to be together in the first place.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I... see. I think what you are saying is correct.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I understand what you mean. But... I just can't 
agree with it.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm not telling you to agree.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] So, what should I do if that happened?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] If he cheats on you, how about you cheat on him?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Huh?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you can't agree with it, you will have to do 
something else with those feelings.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If what you need is a little revenge, then that is 
what you'll have to do.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Revenge... But wouldn't that just make things more 
complicated?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Frankly speaking, I'd normally tell you to endure it 
even if you are shedding bitter tears, but this is an 
ethical problem.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] The youth today probably can't tolerate these old 
values.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] But how can you recommend cheating on him? 
There's no way I could do that!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It doesn't have to be cheating. It can be something 
like an act of compensation.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Host clubbing has been pretty popular among 
young girls lately. Why not try that?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] H... H-H-Host c-c-c-clubbing?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] W-What do you think you're saying to a middle 
schooler?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] *gasp*

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Y-You parried it? No way...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes... That's a magnificent kick.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah... I-I just... Um, my leg just slipped...

[FI] ...Regardless, that was a well-aimed hit towards my 
vital organs.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Your killing intent is the real deal. You moved 
swiftly, but you didn't commit to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You won't be able to defeat your opponent with 
that!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] W-What... Killing intent...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You've got a good and sharp kick, and yet it seems 
like you're holding back somewhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you're serious, don't hold back, never let up. 
That's how you create a warm and loving family.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, of course! But what does cheating have to do 
with...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Naturally, cheating is an unforgivable deed.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Moreover, once married, if something happens and 
neither person can agree to it, you'll be burdened 
for the rest of your lives.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That's why I'm saying it is of paramount 
importance that you do not betray your partner.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] You said that earlier, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] But at the same time, it isn’t strange if something 
were to happen, that's just life.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] And in the first place, everyone has their own 
standards on whether to forgive someone or not.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Once you notice that your standards differ, it's a 
matter of whether you or your partner will change 
to suit the other.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Uu...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] In short, that is what having a harmonious marriage 
and a caring family is all about.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] ...So I suppose both sides will have to compromise 
every now and then?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] But still, I just can't agree.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I don't think I could change just like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Then you just have to make sure you educate 
your partner to avoid him going astray.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Educate him...? Educate my beloved?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That's right. Teach him just how terrible an act of 
betrayal would be. Thoroughly.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Thoroughly...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Is that really okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That is only if you're unable to change your ways. 
However, keep it within the boundaries of common 
sense, got it?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] No... I understand. I will educate him thoroughly.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] So he'll never again leave my side... Fufu.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Sensei, thank you for everything! I will also make 
sure to further improve my kick.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Good.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...And she's gone.
[FI] She can represent Japan someday with that kick...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Today's moral lesson!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]If you fall in love then don't hold 
back, never let up![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] --And so, Daisuke has guided the path of another 
lost maiden. Let us meet on another moonlit night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] ...I wonder if I should educate my husband a bit 
more.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you want to, then do so.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] Fufufu. I'm kidding... I've already finished that long 
ago...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Honey, did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] Nope. ...Dear, it's getting late, so how about we call it 
a night?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Mmm...
